functionEntry.name: finishSyncHoldRelease
functionEntry.documentation:
SELECT released (not canceled): snap to one second after the latest horn not after
remaining-at-press (always uses _syncPressCount from key-down, not current time).

functionEntry.name: cycleStopwatch
functionEntry.documentation: Start / stop / reset cycle — only call from delegate on short SELECT or touch tap while running.

functionEntry.name: <globals/Tuesday_Night_TimerView/<>topHalfHeight>
functionEntry.documentation: Countdown + clip region top edge → divider; ~10% of face below old 50% line (more room for countdown).

functionEntry.name: <globals/Tuesday_Night_TimerView/<>_resetIdleTimeout>
functionEntry.documentation: Reset idle timeout on user activity

functionEntry.name: isInSyncWindow
functionEntry.documentation: True in a 10 s window before a scheduled major horn or in the final 10 s — only time sync is allowed.

functionEntry.name: <globals/Tuesday_Night_TimerView/<>_cleanupAndExit>
functionEntry.documentation: Cleanup all resources and exit the app

functionEntry.name: <globals/Tuesday_Night_TimerView/<>_inTenSecWindowBeforeScheduledHorn>
functionEntry.documentation: True in the 10 s window before a scheduled major horn (same rule as sync for those horns).

functionEntry.name: recordSyncPressAnchor
functionEntry.documentation: Call on physical start key down in sync window — anchors snap-on-release to this tick.

functionEntry.name: exitAppNow
functionEntry.documentation: Public method to exit the app immediately

functionEntry.name: <globals/Tuesday_Night_TimerView/<>countdownDrawY>
functionEntry.documentation: Shift countdown digits upward within the top region.

functionEntry.name: _onIdleCheck
functionEntry.documentation: Check if idle timeout has been exceeded

functionEntry.name: cancelSyncMode
functionEntry.documentation: DOWN during hold-sync: keep current time; exit green overlay (normal colors/rules).

functionEntry.name: onHide
functionEntry.documentation: Stops only the 10 Hz stopwatch redraw ticker. Race countdown uses wall time + 1 s callback and keeps running under Menu2.

functionEntry.name: setStartTime
functionEntry.documentation: Called by the time-select menu when the user picks a new start time

functionEntry.name: <globals/Tuesday_Night_TimerView/<>processRaceWallSeconds>
functionEntry.documentation:
Advances haptics for every whole second the wall clock passed since last fire; ends race at 0:00.
CIQ cannot vibrate while our process is fully suspended; onShow + this loop replays missed seconds when possible.

functionEntry.name: onShow
functionEntry.documentation: When returning from another screen or after the OS paused us, catch up wall-clock seconds and replay missed haptics.

functionEntry.name: onStopwatchUiTick
functionEntry.documentation: ~10 Hz while the stopwatch runs so M:SS:CS updates smoothly.

functionEntry.name: enterSyncMode
functionEntry.documentation:
Long-press confirmed: same countdown as normal, drawn in green until release or cancel.
Returns false if not in a sync window (delegate should not treat as active).

functionEntry.name: <globals/Tuesday_Night_TimerView/<>raceElapsedSec>
functionEntry.documentation: Wall-clock seconds since race start (only meaningful while STATE_RUNNING).

functionEntry.name: <globals/Tuesday_Night_TimerView/<>_hornAppliesToWholeMinute>
functionEntry.documentation: True if `rm` is a scheduled major-horn minute mark and is before the configured start length.

functionEntry.name: callback
functionEntry.documentation: Called by the 1-second timer — advances haptics from wall clock (may batch if we were away).

functionEntry.name: <globals/Tuesday_Night_TimerView/<>maxSignalNotAbove>
functionEntry.documentation: Largest scheduled horn (seconds remaining) with hornTime <= R0; includes 0 for start gun.

functionEntry.name: onHoldThreshold
functionEntry.documentation: Fires while KEY_ENTER is still held; turns on green overlay if still valid.

functionEntry.name: onKey
functionEntry.documentation: Garmin calls this after a full press+release; it can stack with onSelect — consume when release already cycled SW.

functionEntry.name: onSwEnterLongThreshold
functionEntry.documentation: Fires while KEY_ENTER is held (running, outside sync): treat as long press — ignore stopwatch on release.
